canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 4,011 FHA applications Primary Residential Mortgage, Inc. acted on ended without a credit decision: 20.8% withdrawn by the applicant and 3.1% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: Primary Residential Mortgage, Inc. FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that Primary Residential Mortgage, Inc.'s process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that Primary Residential Mortgage, Inc. is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
Primary Residential Mortgage, Inc. discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
